answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence endures only through sustained honest service; a sudden gale of fabricated endorsements cannot instantly restore it. In an EigenTrust-style matrix, freshly spawned sybil identities begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits amplification among colluding peers. Like a jetty protecting a harbor, these checks keep isolated identities from reaching the consensus threshold.
